method.note: drives the shipped phx_recovery::salvage library against real bzip2/xz CLI fixtures; it validates the library rather than re-implementing it
method.confidence: 95% Wilson interval; the gate is on the lower bound

cells.note: the Index survives, so resync is exact
block sizes absent; cannot be bounded without decoding, so we abstain
LZ-coupled, no independent per-block verifier exists

headline.scenario: real xz stream of 10 blocks, mid-stream corruption

stock_tool.outcome: fails the whole stream: Compressed data is corrupt

output_policy.per_block: block_NNNN.bin, emitted only after its own check value verifies
output_policy.joined_payload: payload.bin is written ONLY when recovered blocks tile the output with known offsets and no gap
output_policy.offsets: emitted only when known exactly; after a bzip2 gap the absolute offset is reported as unknown rather than invented
